verdict: The render is geometrically faithful: both circles, the triangle, the AO radius and the OF radius match the original in position and proportion. The only discrepancy is the stroke weight of OF.

issues.description: The radius OF is drawn at the same heavy weight as the other segments. In the original it is a visibly thinner stroke, roughly half the weight of AB, AC and BC. The render's OF is too thick.
issues.suggestion: Give the OF draw command a thinner line width, e.g. \draw[line width=0.7pt] (O) -- (F);, leaving the other segments at 1.5pt.
